_comment: Roles are bundles of permissions. The server checks permissions on every API call; the UI uses the same data only to decide what to show. '*' means every permission.

permissions.dashboard.view: See the dashboard and live status
permissions.site.view: See every Meridian reader at the site and open their UIs
permissions.hardware.view: View I/O map, USB devices, badge readers
permissions.hardware.edit: Change I/O map and device assignments
permissions.access.manage: Change access lists, sync sources and schedules
permissions.tools.view: View tag-to-tool cache and unknown tags
permissions.tools.edit: Resolve unknown tags, change tool cache settings
permissions.integrations.view: View MQTT, HTTP and file export settings
permissions.kiosk.edit: Change kiosk layout, prompts and branding
permissions.data.view: View event log and database tables
permissions.data.import: Import reference tables (CSV), e.g. CribMaster exports
permissions.license.view: See license status, licensee and expiry
permissions.dev.tools: Developer tools: raw events, API explorer, debug logs, feature flags
permissions.network.diag: Run network tests from the reader (port, DNS, ping, DHCP status)

site_admin.label: Site Admin
site_admin.description: Customer IT or crib manager. Accounts, credentials, certificates, audit.

technician.label: Technician
technician.description: Field installer. Hardware, RFID, rules, integrations, kiosk setup.

supervisor.label: Supervisor
supervisor.description: Day-to-day operations. Sessions, alarms, overrides, unknown tags.

viewer.label: Viewer
viewer.description: Read-only dashboards, history and audit log.

operator.label: Operator
operator.description: Shop-floor user. Kiosk only; no access to this configuration UI.
